Feature: PCIe DBI/SII/PHY Register Read/Write and Reset Verification
Test Description: Verifies reset defaults and read/write integrity for DBI control, SII, and PHY control registers across PCIe0 and PCIe1. Applies masked writes and 16-bit PHY accesses, reads back, and checks for mismatches. Test passes when no mismatches are detected.
Meta Test Description: The test prints entry messages, then executes two phases: (1) Reset value check (chk_rst_val): For rc0_ctl_addr[5] and rc1_ctl_addr[5] (DBI control registers), reads each and compares to ctl_default[5] (all 0x0). For sii0_addr[3] and sii1_addr[3] (SII registers), reads and compares to sii_default[3] (all 0x0). Writes 0x01203000 to mizar_PCIE0_SII_PHY_RST_CONTROL and mizar_PCIE1_SII_PHY_RST_CONTROL. For PHY addresses phy0_addr[3] = {0xE68860B8,0xE68862B8,0xE68864B8} and phy1_addr[3] = {0xE68A60B8,0xE68A62B8,0xE68A64B8}, reads each 32-bit value, extracts upper 16 bits if (addr % 4) != 0 else lower 16 bits, and compares to respective defaults (phy0_default[3]/phy1_default[3], all 0x0). Any mismatch increments err1 or err2 and logs. (2) Read/Write check (chk_rd_wr): Iterates j over 3 patterns (from chk_val[6], first three used in loops): for each DBI control addr in rc0_ctl_addr and rc1_ctl_addr, writes chk_val[j]; for each SII addr in sii0_addr and sii1_addr, writes (chk_val[j] & respective write_mask); writes SII PHY reset control 0x01203000 for both instances; writes to PHY addresses phy0_addr[i]/phy1_addr[i] with (chk_val_phy[j] & phy*_write_mask[i]). Then reads back and compares: DBI control values must equal chk_val[j]; SII values must equal (chk_val[j] & mask). For PHY reads, again extract upper or lower 16 bits depending on address alignment; comparison checks (data_rd & phy*_write_mask[i]) == (chk_val_phy[j] & 0x1FFF). Any mismatch increments err1. Finally, finish(err2 || err1) is called; a pass corresponds to both counters being zero.
Remarks: Requires access to DBI, SII, and PHY control spaces for both PCIe instances. SII writes must respect field masks. PHY checks use 16-bit fields selected by address alignment. Test passes only if defaults and read-backs match expected values with no errors.
Test Steps / Procedure:
1. Read DBI control registers for PCIe0 and PCIe1 and verify they match reset defaults (0x0).
2. Read SII registers for PCIe0 and PCIe1 and verify they match reset defaults (0x0).
3. Assert the PCIe SII PHY reset control for both instances.
4. Read PCIe PHY control locations for both instances; evaluate the appropriate 16-bit half and confirm they match defaults (0x0).
5. For multiple data patterns, write DBI control, SII (with masks), and PHY registers (masked 16-bit), then read back and compare against expected masked values.
6. Record any mismatches; declare pass only if no errors are detected.
